dofile(GetInfo(60) .. "aardwolf_colors.lua") -- Used to support Aard Colors for the cnote() function require "tprint" require "gmcphelper" require "serialize" local prevZone, currentZone = "123prev_zone", "123current_zone" local to_bool = {["0"] = false, ["1"] = true} -- Basic print function that supports aard, xterm, and ANSI color codes [idea from Durel's Inventory script]
function cnote(string) AnsiNote(stylesToANSI(ColoursToStyles(string))) end
--[[ SKD ]]-- -- Variables for use throughout script prepend = "@D[@x086S@x044K@x043D@D]:"
--[[ Damage Vulnerabilities for Pylons Cerulean = Bash, Earth, Energy, Fire, Light Lilac = Acid, Air, Electric, Holy, Negative, Slash, Sonic Seafoam = Cold, Magic, Mental, Pierce, Shadow, Water
]]
-- Do not set these, they're set by internal functions or with aliases _cmdAttack = "" _cmdWeapon = "" _canRoom = "" _shouldSwapWeapon = false _skdAim = "ceiling" configs = { skdQuiet = true } -- Prettified room direction callouts _prettifiedRoomNames = { { room = "28379", name = "N alc" }, { room = "28380", name = "N" }, { room = "28381", name = "NW" }, { room = "28383", name = "W" }, { room = "28384", name = "W alc" }, { room = "28387", name = "SW" },
{ room = "28389", name = "S" },
{ room = "28390", name = "S alc" },
{ room = "28388", name = "SE" },
{ room = "28385", name = "E" },
{ room = "28386", name = "E alc" }, { room = "28382", name = "NE" } }
-- Store the textcolour values for each pylon color _slashColor=ColoursToStyles("@x147")[1].textcolour -- lilac _lightColor=ColoursToStyles("@x075")[1].textcolour -- cerulean _mentalColor=ColoursToStyles("@x159")[1].textcolour -- crystal _yellowColor=ColoursToStyles("@Y")[1].textcolour _cyanColor=ColoursToStyles("@C")[1].textcolour _redColor=ColoursToStyles("@R")[1].textcolour _x039Color=ColoursToStyles("@x039")[1].textcolour _x075Color=ColoursToStyles("@x075")[1].textcolour _x024Color=ColoursToStyles("@x024")[1].textcolour
function init_skd_data() skd_data = { healcheck = 0, hc_time = 0, starttime = 0, endtime = 0, pylons_or_heal = '', moon_rooms = {} } end
init_skd_data()
function skd_epic_start(name,line,wildcards,styles) Execute("sendgmcp config autoassist off") Send("fol self") end function skd_heal_check(name,line,wildcards,styles) if styles[1].textcolour == _redColor then skd_data.healcheck = skd_data.healcheck + 1 if skd_data.healcheck > 1 then diff = os.clock() - skd_data.hc_time else diff = 0 end skd_data.hc_time = os.clock() cnote(("%s @RHeal Check[@W%d@w/@G6@R]@w @D(timer: %d)@w"):format(prepend,skd_data.healcheck,diff)) end end function skd_pylon_colors(name, line, args, styles) if pylonFight[args.color] then skd_pylon_update(args.color) else ColourNote("yellow",""," >> ", "red","","SKD plugin does not recognize this pylon color.") end end function skd_pylon_colorstoo(name, line, args, styles) local txtColour = "unknown" local pylonColour = "unknown" for k,v in ipairs(styles) do if (string.lower(v.text) == "a crystal pylon") then txtColour = v.textcolour break end end if (txtColour == _slashColor) then pylonColour = "lilac" elseif txtColour == _lightColor then pylonColour = "cerulean" elseif (txtColour == _mentalColor) then pylonColour = "seafoam" end -- Note("(DEBUG) Plugin detected the spawn of this color pylon: " .. pylonColour) if pylonFight[pylonColour] then skd_pylon_update(pylonColour) else ColourNote("yellow",""," >> ", "red","","SKD plugin does not recognize this pylon color.") end end function skd_pylon_update(colour) if (_cmdWeapon ~= pylonFight[colour]["weapon"]) then _shouldSwapWeapon = true end -- Note("(DEBUG) _shouldSwapWeapon = " .. tostring(_shouldSwapWeapon)) _cmdWeapon = pylonFight[colour]["weapon"] _cmdAttack = pylonFight[colour]["cmdAttack"] --Note("weapon now " .. tostring(_cmdWeapon)) --Note("attack now " .. tostring(_cmdAttack)) end function seaking_taunt_hit(name, line, wildcards, styles) if styles[1].textcolour == _yellowColor then Send( ("gt %s @YTaunt@W hit!!@w"):format(prepend) ) end end function seaking_movement(name, line, wildcards, styles) -- if styles[1].textcolour == _cyanColor then if name == "triggerSKLeap" then Send( ("gt %s @WSea King has leaped! @RPylons @Wor @RHeal Check @WPhase."):format(prepend) ) skd_data.pylons_or_heal = '' -- reset pylon vs heal phase DoAfterSpecial(3, 'report_pylon_events()', 12) -- in 3 seconds, check if pylon phase and start report timers _canRoom = "" -- reset cannon room EnableTrigger('triggerSKDEpicCannonFound', true) -- enable cannon found trigger elseif name == "triggerSKLand" then Send( ("gt %s @WSea King is grounded! @RTaunt @Wor @RKill @WPhase."):format(prepend) ) skd_data.moon_rooms = {} elseif name == "triggerSKHealCheck" then skd_data.healcheck = 0 skd_data.pylons_or_heal = 'heal' Send( ("gt %s @RHeal Check @Wphase confirmed! @R[@W%d@w/@G6@R]@w"):format(prepend,skd_data.healcheck) ) end -- end end
function seaking_target(name, line, wildcards, styles) local room = gmcp("room.info.num") local kingHP = gmcp("char.status.enemypct") local text = ""
for k, v in ipairs(_prettifiedRoomNames) do if v["room"] == room then text = v["name"] break end end
if styles[1].textcolour == _x039Color then Send( ("gt %s @RSea King@x208(" .. kingHP .. "%%)@W is targetting me!@w - @R" .. text .. "@w" ):format(prepend) ) end end
function skd_epic_reset( name, line, wildcards, styles ) if styles[1].textcolour == _x024Color then Send( ("gt %s @x038Epic reset!!@w"):format(prepend) ) end end --[[ SQLite Database Functions ]]-- function init_db() local db_path = ("%sdata\\skd_epic_runs.db"):format(GetInfo(64)) local db, err = sqlite3.open(db_path) if err ~= nil then print("Error opening database: " .. err) return nil end -- Create the table if it doesn't exist local create_table_sql = [[ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skd_epic_runs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, date TEXT, trains INTEGER, qp INTEGER, gold INTEGER ); ]] local res, err = db:exec(create_table_sql) if err ~= nil then print("Error creating table: " .. err) db:close() return nil end db:close() return db_path end function insert_run(connection_string, trains, qp, gold) local db, err = sqlite3.open(connection_string) if err ~= nil then print("Error opening database: " .. err) return false end local date = os.date("%Y-%m-%d") local insert_sql = string.format([[ INSERT INTO skd_epic_runs (date, trains, qp, gold) VALUES ('%s', %d, %d, %d); ]], date, trains, qp, gold) local res, err = db:exec(insert_sql) if err ~= nil then print("Error inserting record: " .. err) db:close() return false end db:close() return true end function get_todays_stats(connection_string) local db, err = sqlite3.open(connection_string) if err ~= nil then print("Error opening database: " .. err) return nil end local query = string.format( [[ SELECT COUNT(*) as runs ,COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) as total_trains ,COALESCE(SUM(qp),0) as total_qp ,COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) as total_gold ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(trains) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_trains ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(qp) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_qp ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(gold) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_gold FROM skd_epic_runs WHERE date = strftime('%%Y-%%m-%%d', 'now', 'localtime') ]], date) local stats = {} for row in db:nrows(query) do stats.runs = tonumber(row.runs) stats.total_trains = tonumber(row.total_trains) stats.total_qp = tonumber(row.total_qp) stats.total_gold = tonumber(row.total_gold) stats.avg_trains = tonumber(row.avg_trains) stats.avg_qp = tonumber(row.avg_qp) stats.avg_gold = tonumber(row.avg_gold) end db:close() return stats end function get_thisweek_stats(connection_string) local db, err = sqlite3.open(connection_string) if err ~= nil then print("Error opening database: " .. err) return nil end local query = [[ SELECT COUNT(*) as runs ,COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) as total_trains ,COALESCE(SUM(qp),0) as total_qp ,COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) as total_gold ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(trains) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_trains ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(qp) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_qp ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(gold) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_gold FROM skd_epic_runs WHERE strftime('%Y-%W', date) = strftime('%Y-%W', 'now') ]] local stats = {} for row in db:nrows(query) do stats.runs = tonumber(row.runs) stats.total_trains = tonumber(row.total_trains) stats.total_qp = tonumber(row.total_qp) stats.total_gold = tonumber(row.total_gold) stats.avg_trains = tonumber(row.avg_trains) stats.avg_qp = tonumber(row.avg_qp) stats.avg_gold = tonumber(row.avg_gold) end db:close() return stats end function get_lifetime_stats(connection_string) local db, err = sqlite3.open(connection_string) if err ~= nil then print("Error opening database: " .. err) return nil end local query = string.format( [[ SELECT COUNT(*) as runs ,COALESCE(SUM(trains),0) as total_trains ,COALESCE(SUM(qp),0) as total_qp ,COALESCE(SUM(gold),0) as total_gold ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(trains) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_trains ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(qp) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_qp ,COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(gold) as INTEGER)),0) as avg_gold FROM skd_epic_runs ]], date) local stats = {} for row in db:nrows(query) do stats.runs = tonumber(row.runs) stats.total_trains = tonumber(row.total_trains) stats.total_qp = tonumber(row.total_qp) stats.total_gold = tonumber(row.total_gold) stats.avg_trains = tonumber(row.avg_trains) stats.avg_qp = tonumber(row.avg_qp) stats.avg_gold = tonumber(row.avg_gold) end db:close() return stats end --[[ Formatting functions ]]-- function comma_value(amount) local formatted = amount while true do formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2') if (k==0) then break end end return formatted end --[[ Rewards Tracking Functions ]]-- function init_rewards() reward = { qp=0, gold=0, trains=0, items = { } } end function activateRewards( name, line, wildcards, styles ) init_rewards() EnableTrigger("rewardedGoldTrains", true ) EnableTrigger("rewardedQP", true ) EnableTrigger("rewardedItem", true ) EnableTrigger("reportRewards", true ) EnableTrigger("activateRewards", false ) end function reportRewards( name, line, wildcards, styles ) EnableTrigger("rewardedGoldTrains", false ) EnableTrigger("rewardedQP", false ) EnableTrigger("rewardedItem", false ) EnableTrigger("reportRewards", false ) EnableTrigger("activateRewards", true )
EnableTrigger('triggerSKDEpicCannonFound', false) -- disable cannon found trigger
Execute("sendgmcp config autoassist on")
-- Reset values as fallback _cmdWeapon = "" _cmdAttack = "" _canRoom = ""
rewards = print_rewards(reward) Send(("%s %s"):format("gt", rewards)) local total_time = os.time() - skd_data.starttime Execute("gt " .. disp_time(total_time) .. "$C" .. print_pups(reward,total_time) .. "$C" ) -- Report epic run time end function processRewards( name, line, wildcards, styles ) if name=="rewardedGoldTrains" then rgold = string.gsub(wildcards.gold, ",", "") rtrain = string.gsub(wildcards.trains, ",", "") reward.gold = tonumber(reward.gold) + tonumber(rgold) reward.trains = tonumber(reward.trains) + tonumber(rtrain) elseif name=="rewardedQP" then reward.qp = tonumber(reward.qp) + tonumber(wildcards.qp) elseif name=="rewardedItem" then table.insert(reward.items, wildcards.item) end end function print_pups(reward_table, total_time) local trains_pup = 5.2 -- how many trains per pup local pups = ""
for key, value in pairs(reward_table) do if type(value) ~= "table" then if (key == "trains" and value > 0) then pups = string.format("%.2f", value / trains_pup) end end end if (pups ~= "") then local times_pup = "unknown" if (total_time ~= nil) then times_pup = string.format("%.2f",tonumber(total_time) / tonumber(pups)) end --local message = "@Y >> @w Pup equivalent: @W " .. pups .. " @Y pups at @W " .. tostring(times_pup) .. "@ws" --CallPlugin("b555825a4a5700c35fa80780","storeFromOutside", message) --Send("echo " .. message) message = "@w, Pup equivalent:@W " .. pups .. "@G pups at @W" .. tostring(times_pup) .. "@ws" return message else Note("SKD issue: did not see pups in rewards table") end
end function print_rewards(reward_table) items = "" gold_reward = "" trains_reward = "" qp_reward = "" message = "" pups = "" for key, value in pairs(reward_table) do if type(value) == "table" then if #value > 0 then for i = 1, #value do if #items == 0 then items = ("@WItems: @D[@G%s@D]@w"):format(value[i]) else items = ("%s@D, [@G%s@D]@w"):format(items,value[i]) end end end else if key == "gold" and value > 0 then gold_reward = (("%s@wGold[@Y%s@w]@w "):format(gold_reward,comma_value(value))) elseif key == "trains" and value > 0 then trains_reward = (("%s@wTrains[@C%s@w]@w "):format(trains_reward,comma_value(value))) elseif key == "qp" and value > 0 then qp_reward = (("%s@wQP[@M%s@w]@w "):format(qp_reward,comma_value(value))) end end end message = trains_reward .. gold_reward .. qp_reward .. items -- process database entry -- local db = init_db() -- if db ~= nil then -- local success = insert_run(db, reward_table.trains, reward_table.qp, reward_table.gold) -- if success then -- cnote( ("%s insert_run() success!"):format(prepend) ) -- end -- else -- cnote( ("%s insert_run() failed to initialize database!"):format(prepend) ) -- end
return message end function ALIAS_report(name,line,args) local db = init_db() if ((args.type:lower() ~= 'daily') and (args.type:lower() ~= 'life') and (args.type:lower() ~= 'weekly')) then cnote( ("%s@W You need to provide either @Ydaily@W, @Yweekly@W, or @Ylife@W as the argument.@w"):format(prepend) ) return end if db ~= nil then if args.type == 'daily' then ts = get_todays_stats(db) ttype = "Daily" elseif args.type == 'life' then ts = get_lifetime_stats(db) ttype = "Lifetime" elseif args.type == 'weekly' then ts = get_thisweek_stats(db) ttype = "Weekly" end if ts ~= nil then msg = ("%s @D%s Totals[@wCount(@R%s@w) @wTrains(@C%s@w) Gold(@Y%s@w) QP(@M%d@w)@D] Averages[@wTrains(@C%s@w) Gold(@Y%s@w) QP(@M%s@w)@D]@w"):format(prepend, ttype,comma_value(ts.runs), comma_value(ts.total_trains), comma_value(ts.total_gold), comma_value(ts.total_qp), comma_value(ts.avg_trains), comma_value(ts.avg_gold), comma_value(ts.avg_qp)) Send( ("%s %s"):format("gt", msg) ) end else cnote( ("%s insert_run() failed to initialize database!"):format(prepend) ) end end
function attack() if (_cmdWeapon ~= "" and _cmdAttack ~= "") then if (_shouldSwapWeapon) then Execute(_cmdWeapon) _shouldSwapWeapon = false end if (gmcp("char.status.pos") == "Fighting") then Execute(_cmdAttack .. " pylon") elseif pylonFight["options"]["preferBackstab"] then Send("backstab pylon") Send("kill pylon") else Execute(_cmdAttack .. " pylon") end else cnote( "@RFind a pylon first!@w" ) end end
function cmdReportCannon() local room = gmcp("room.info.num") local text = ""
for k, v in ipairs(_prettifiedRoomNames) do if v["room"] == room then text = v["name"] break end end
if text ~= "" then Execute( "gt @D[@WSKD@D]:@G Cannon: @W" .. text .. "@w" ) _canRoom = room else cnote( "@RNot in SKD area@w" ) end end
function skd_epic_cannon_found() cmdReportCannon() EnableTrigger('triggerSKDEpicCannonFound', false) -- disable cannon found trigger end
function cmdLoadCannon() -- on_getting_pylon_dust() -- this reports getting dust to GT if _canRoom ~= "" then Execute("mapper walkto " .. _canRoom) Execute("load cannon") if _skdAim == 'floor' then Execute("aim floor") else Execute("aim ceiling") end Execute("fire cannon") else cnote( "@RCannon room not set@w" ) end end
function cmdReportMoon() local room = gmcp("room.info.num") local text = ""
for k, v in ipairs(_prettifiedRoomNames) do if v["room"] == room then text = v["name"] break end end
if text ~= "" then Execute( "gt @D[@WSKD@D]:@G Moon: @W" .. text .. "@w" ) skd_data.moon_rooms = {} else cnote( "@RNot in SKD area@w" ) end end
function skd_epic_start_specter() skd_data.starttime = os.time() _cmdWeapon = "" _cmdAttack = "" _canRoom = "" _shouldSwapWeapon = false end
function report_lizaard_times() if configs.skdQuiet == false then Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]:@G Lizaard @Wexploding in @G90@W seconds. Next warning in @G60@W seconds.@w") DoAfterSpecial(60, 'Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]:@G Lizaard @Wexploding in @G30@W seconds.@w")', 12) DoAfterSpecial(78, 'Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]:@G Lizaard @Wexploding in @G12@W seconds.@w")', 12) end end
function report_pylon_events() if configs.skdQuiet == false then if skd_data.pylons_or_heal ~= 'heal' then Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]:@GPylons @Wphase started!@w") DoAfterSpecial(22, 'Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]: @GPylons @Wexploding in @G10 @Wseconds@w")', 12) DoAfterSpecial(36, 'Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]: @GPylons @Wphase @G2/3@w")', 12) DoAfterSpecial(62, 'Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]: @GPylons @Wexploding in @G10 @Wseconds@w")', 12) DoAfterSpecial(72, 'Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]: @GPylons @Wphase @G3/3@w")', 12) end end end
function mark_moon(name,line,wildcards,styles) local roomNumber = gmcp("room.info.num") if name == 'skd_moon_description' then local found = false for i, room in ipairs(skd_data.moon_rooms) do if room.room == roomNumber then found = true if room.count > 5 then cmdReportMoon() else room.count = room.count + 1 end break end end if not found then -- If roomNumber was not found, insert a new entry with count 1 table.insert(skd_data.moon_rooms, { room = roomNumber, count = 1 }) end end
if name == 'skd_moon_bad' then for i, room in ipairs(skd_data.moon_rooms) do if room.room == roomNumber then room.count = 1 break end end end end
function on_cannon_fire_self() if configs.skdQuiet == false then local charName = gmcp("char.base.name") Execute(string.format("gt @D[@WSKD@D]: @G%s @Wfired cannon!@w", charName)) end end
function on_getting_pylon_dust() if configs.skdQuiet == false then Execute("gt @D[@WSKD@D]: @WGot pylon dust!@w") end end
function toggleCannonAim() if _skdAim == 'ceiling' then _skdAim = 'floor' print("Aiming floor") else _skdAim = 'ceiling' print("Aiming ceiling") end end
function toggleReporting() if configs.skdQuiet == true then configs.skdQuiet = false print("SKD reporting set to loud") else configs.skdQuiet = true print("SKD reporting set to quiet") end end
function disp_time(time) local days = math.floor(time/86400) local remaining = time % 86400 local hours = math.floor(remaining/3600) remaining = remaining % 3600 local minutes = math.floor(remaining/60) remaining = remaining % 60 local seconds = remaining if (hours < 10) then hours = "0" .. tostring(hours) end if (minutes < 10) then minutes = "0" .. tostring(minutes) end if (seconds < 10) then seconds = "0" .. tostring(seconds) end
if hours == "00" and days == 0 then return "@D[@WSKD@D]:@G " .. "Finished in:@Y " .. minutes..':'..seconds else return "@RTime too long, assuming error" end end function send_dots(dots) for i = 1, dots do ColourTell("cyan", "", "-", "cyan", "", "-") end Tell("\n") end function padRight(text, length, padChar) local this_text = tostring(text) local padding = length - string.len(this_text) for i = 1, padding do this_text = this_text .. padChar end return this_text end function OnPluginInstall () assert (loadstring (GetVariable ("configs") or "")) () end -- function OnPluginInstall
function OnPluginSaveState () SetVariable ("configs", "configs = " .. serialize.save_simple (configs)) end -- function OnPluginSaveState
